$description: Apollo Ecosystem — LIVE DEEP AUDIT (2026-07-20) after P1/P2/P3 remediations — 39 plugins. Permission-body REST analysis + filesystem SSOT. Canonical: plugins/_inventory/apollo-registry.json (mirror: apollo-registry-2.json).

$header.IMPORTANT_runtime_alignment: MANDATORY: EVERY platform update MUST keep apollo-runtime aligned with all active plugins/contracts.
$header.CRITICAL_apollo_core_centralization: MANDATORY: ALL meta keys, CPTs, and taxonomies MUST be registered EXCLUSIVELY through apollo-core. NO direct register_post_meta/register_post_type/register_taxonomy calls anywhere else. apollo-core owns MASTER_REGISTRY + GLOBAL BRIDGE pattern.
$header.registry_deploy_workflow: Phase 0 (interim): 1) Edit plugins/_inventory/apollo-registry.json (monolith canonical). 2) Copy to wp-content/apollo-registry.json. 3) Registry::clear_cache() or bump mu-plugins/apollo-route-setup.php apollo_route_setup_version. 4) Save permalinks if rewrite rules changed. 5) Optional: POST /apollo/v1/registry/inventory-sync to refresh runtime_wordpress_packages. 6) Never merge apolloDJ desktop JSON into WordPress. Phase 2: modular chapters + wp apollo registry build will replace steps 1-2 — see plugins/_inventory/_plans/PHASE2-DEFERRED-OPTION-A.md
$header.desktop_app_registry_note: apolloDJ desktop SSOT: build/_inventory apolloDJ/apolloDJ-registry.json (separate product; not loaded by WordPress). WP REST: apollo-login owns /apollo/v1/app/* and GET /dj/config + GET /dj/permissions; apollo-dj-sync owns POST /apollo/v1/dj/session only (divergence D1).
